name: Cereceda de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Square flag gyronny of twelve pieces of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cereceda de la Sierra (a cherry tree on red and a black bend on white).
history: The arms of Cereceda de la Sierra were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 5 November 1997; the municipal flag was approved on 12 March 1998 and is square, gyronny of six gyrons of silver and six of gules, with the arms over all.

features.role: gyronny of twelve pieces radiating from the centre
